alternatives_rejected.why: Its own span self-time stayed at 0.2ms (0.99x), and the inbound slowdown appears only on calls from checkoutservice, so its high latency metric is caller-observed (E2).

It is one of 6 checkoutservice callees that all slowed together. A shared slowdown across every callee points to the caller's network, not shippingservice (E3). Its latency deviation in E1 is likely inflated by those calls.

proposed_fix.description: Find and remove the injected network delay on the checkoutservice pod's interface, for example a tc netem qdisc rule. Then confirm that checkoutservice p50/p90 latency and inbound self-time return to baseline of about 4ms.
